description: Read CRICOS course topics by code or URL. Defaults to core. For a language course, core, overview and English requirements return schools that recognise that CRICOS course and the scope, target courses and campuses, conditions, validity and sources of each published match. Explicit nonempty sections replace the default: core, overview, fees, requirements, intakes, campuses, pathways, packages, similar, majors, offerings. Offerings returns annual morning/evening classes, exact duration/fee rules and start dates. Offering amounts are AUD cents. To calculate a class quote pass offerings.year, offerings.offeringId and offerings.quote {audience,weeks,startDate}; offers remain conditional until school confirmation. Majors are directions within this CRICOS course; a listed option does not imply compulsory selection or availability at every campus/intake. Majors list only real directions with display names, extended-major flags and English descriptions; the original application name is kept as name, and placeholder or Undeclared options are classified by kind. The default core summary lists up to 20 major options with short descriptions (cached with core, so description edits may lag one cache period). Intakes mark matched school-wide application deadlines separately from course-confirmed teaching dates and retain verified intake closures. Topic options must be nested under their selected section. Full semantic entries are preserved; subsequent pages require unchanged contentVersion. Fees include exact-year domestic on-campus and online totals when supplied, with any price conditions attached. Select fees.audience=domestic for both modes. Fees also include the optional audience-specific payment plan; campuses include optional annual general/campus teaching arrangements. Payment plans have no campus dimension. Requirements topics are english, entry, placement, licensing, accreditation and research; omitted topics read all of them. Research gives research-degree admission, course structure and deadlines by exact year. Entry includes recognised prerequisite short courses by target intake year; use requirements.feeRegion for region-specific pricing. English includes recorded provider wording by exact year, including OET where published. Use fee years/audience, requirement topics, date/campus filters or pageSize to narrow large responses. State government school courses (e.g. VIC 019048F) include state-wide tuition by year level, all published charges, first-invoice and first-year estimates, term deadlines and entry rules; fees.stateSchool narrows the estimate to one year level, start term and accommodation. includeEvidence explicitly requests provider evidence separately from sections; website OAuth is required only on the public endpoint. Core and overview include hesaProvider for the provider and, for postgraduate-level courses, onshoreProgression: whether a student visa holder who completed a higher education course may apply in Australia for this course (LIN 26/087, from 2 Oct 2026); it never establishes personal eligibility. includeSimilar and unknown arguments are rejected. This public endpoint returns English natural-language text, preserving sources, conditions and pagination.

stateSchool.description: State government school courses only: narrow the first-invoice and first-year estimates to one combination. startTerm and startYear go together.

yearLevel.description: Year level the student starts in; 0 is the first school year (Prep, Kindergarten, Reception, Transition or Pre-primary).

includeEvidence.description: Explicitly read provider evidence, independent of the selected public sections. Website OAuth is required only on the public endpoint.

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.

passportCountry.description: Passport-country code, with no default; not current residence.

feeRegion.description: Optional two-letter country code, e.g. AU. If omitted, verified regional quotes retain their quoted region. A quote for another requested region is replaced by an official pricing link.

topics.description: Omit to read every topic. english includes published language course levels, provider-recognised pathways and course exceptions and exact-year provider wording such as OET. entry includes recognised prerequisite short courses by exact intake year. research: research-degree admission by exact year (supervisor policy, entry routes, documents, interview, steps, course structure, deadlines).

studentType.description: Document Checklist student category. Only 01 is supported for documentary outcomes; no default.

name: get_course
title: Read selected course topics
